geometry: A single white, four-direction arrow silhouette with straight 45-degree arrowhead edges. The 20 by 20 canvas has 2-unit-wide crossing shafts and arrowheads extending 4 units from each edge; the original uses fully opaque white with half-alpha diagonal edge pixels.
limitations: The smooth diagonal edges are rasterized by the SVG renderer and may differ slightly from the source at individual edge pixels. The 8x rendering was visually inspected.
